Verified success permits conditional advance without repeated step approvals; distinct step clocks remain clipped to the immutable parent. Stop on failure, Unknown, input drift or budget exhaustion, with no automatic retry or renewed clock. Only closed verified derivations can feed later steps. Prove actual engine graphroot/runroot/temp/output/process isolation; original outcomes and old holds remain separate from current metadata. Early real credential/policy/workflow/runtime preflight and typed observations remain substantive. Runner, bake, registration and first consumer retain priority. Reusable builder and desktop preparation and source-bound artifact handoff do not establish native qualification. Source delivery and installed instruction/caller adoption stay distinct. Public coordination returns https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6398426496 and https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6398854743 record two completed finite source-delivery envelopes using the receiver owner existing capabilities: each retained a single apply, exact source and native readback, independent original-scope retirement and its original clock. These observations demonstrate the source-delivery path only; no native engine/bake/consumer acceptance or general economic saving follows. Restricted raw evidence remains in owner custody.

Review the smallest complete real runtime prefix before assembling every bake member. A changed engine mode must propagate through actual member argv/cgroup parent, callback arguments and namespace/pause proof consumers; constructor controls alone missed those couplings in the public review disposition https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6398899828. The subsequent initialization-only source return and review https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6399239792 retain a separate external-wrapper/original-clock/cold-observer prerequisite. An internal clock minted after outer setup is not one shared original; every descendant phase must fit the selected parent, with enough bounded retirement and independent collection time. Source, callback tuple witnesses, actual callback settlement and native cleanup are distinct evidence. A later empty scope is current observation, not proof of independent retirement inside a missed original window. The public metadata disposition https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6399286740 preserves that gap without replaying a read-only original or making it a global hold on demonstrated-independent fresh work.

Production diagnostic producers belong in early real-path controls. The repository-owned coordination/c2-public-failure-counterpart-retention record describes the closed actual owner-receipt census and producer-driven retention control. The selected BAR repair restored a complete diagnostic tuple in subsequent failed hosted qualification, while the client emitted no explanatory compiler detail. The original timeout and later nonzero client/owned-descendant refusal are separate failures; restored reporting and cleanup do not establish the compiler cause, model success or retry eligibility. A provider command has its own original clock, independently of earlier canonical work. Preserve required failed gates, no unchanged retry/budget increase or ownership waiver; investigate actual emitted evidence. These are correctness and delegation observations, not measured token savings.
